newsitem.title: USA: Dana buys German injection molding company.
newsitem.headline: Dana buys German injection molding company.

text.p: Dana Corp said on Wednesday it bought German injection molding company Thermoplast+Apparatebau GmbH, for undisclosed terms.

Thermoplast, based in Idstein, Germany, specializes in the design, engineering and manufacture of high-precision, injection-molded plastic components and systems for automotive applications. It had 1995 sales of $35 million, Dana said.
Dana said the acquisition would help Dana expand its leadership in the global automotive sealing products area, to meet growing demand for integrated sealing components.
